authority: Direct user request relayed by control on 2026-11-04: test H3 using fund return minus an index, with equity/mixed funds relative to the Moscow Exchange equity index and bond funds relative to a bond index; retain four groups and provide a table.
prior_results_known: Earlier alpha and relaxed-news H3 results are known. This is an explicitly requested post-baseline alternative outcome, frozen before its own estimates, not the original ex ante alpha design or an outcome chosen after inspecting this new grid.

method_review.meaning: A legitimate descriptive test of future index-relative performance. It is not factor alpha, comprehensive risk adjustment, proof of skill or a causal effect.
method_review.data_readiness: The data-service reviewer must verify and pin the exact IMOEX and RGBITR sources, monthly endpoints and eligible coverage before the first coefficient run. This file does not certify uninspected benchmark data.

parent_contracts.precedence: Inherit only the frozen origin/universe, identity, unit-return quality, quantity, news-score, zero/NA and inference rules identified here. This file overrides all alpha/factor eligibility, alpha-history requirements, outcome definition, past_alpha control and the prior 48-cell grid. Never inherit a parent alpha-defined or alpha-eligible mask.

storage_and_preservation.rules: Write new derived artifacts only. H1/H2, every old H3 version, source manifests, protected resources, live Gemma inputs/results and mapping selections stay unchanged. Bulk panels and used samples remain on PC. No new LLM, extra return branch, grid search, watcher or automation. RESEARCH_NOTES is maintained by control, not this reviewer.

fund_returns.eligibility: Use the frozen diagnostic_eligible, dated identity, finite return and observed endpoint/action-comparability information. This is unit-value growth with known adjustments, not total NAV growth and not payout-complete verified total return. Retain known distribution/split adjustments and unresolved-event exclusions; do not reclassify unknown payouts as absent.
fund_returns.no_alpha_gate: Do not require a factor join, factors_verified, risk-free coverage, historical beta, n_past, n_recent, alpha, past_alpha, factor rank or any saved alpha inclusion flag. A valid fund-month remains usable when an unrelated factor or alpha is unavailable.

fixed_inputs.benchmark_sources: Data-service-owned, separately sealed input manifest before coefficients, with series IDs, raw source paths, hashes, units, return conventions, actual endpoint dates and eligibility. Reusing verified RGBITR monthly values is allowed; their eligibility must be series-specific, not gated by unrelated equity/RUONIA fields. No silent IMOEX-to-MCFTR or RGBITR-to-RGBI substitution.

notation.f: Fund with the inherited verified dated identifier.
notation.t: Selected genuine holdings interval, ending at actual origin date d_t; t is not assumed to be a calendar month.
notation.d_t: Actual closing report date of the selected holdings interval.
notation.g_f_t: Inherited report-dated focus: equity, bond or mixed, fixed at origin for this observation.
notation.b_f_t: Benchmark selected from g_f_t: IMOEX for equity/mixed and RGBITR for bond.
notation.r_f_m: Frozen eligible monthly RUB fund-unit return, in decimal units, for calendar month m.
notation.I_b_m: Verified official level of benchmark b at the last eligible trading close of calendar month m, with the actual date retained.
notation.r_b_m: Simple monthly benchmark return I_b_m/I_b_(m-1)-1, using adjacent complete monthly endpoints and the index's own return convention.
notation.ER_f_m_b: Fund-minus-index monthly return r_f_m-r_b_m; the benchmark is b_f_t for this origin.
notation.Y_f_t_h: Mean monthly index-relative performance over the h full calendar months after m_t.
notation.S_lagnews: Unchanged NTS_Q_lagnews_relaxed: CURRENT measured quantity changes aligned with PREVIOUS-interval news, not lagged trades or a lagged value of S_current.
notation.m_star: Latest eligible complete past calendar month satisfying the date rules below for this fund and its origin-selected benchmark.
notation.P_f_t: Past index-relative return ER_f_m_star_b, the only control; its actual month and age are retained.
notation.theta_current_theta_lagnews: Conditional associations of future index-relative performance with the current and lagnews scores.
notation.N_G: Number of fitted fund-origin observations and distinct fund clusters after singleton removal.
notation.K_full: Identified model rank including fund fixed effects, for the CR1 correction and residual degrees of freedom.

mixed.label: MOEX Russia Index, price return; common equity yardstick, not a balanced-portfolio benchmark

bond.label: Russian government-bond total-return index, including the index's accrued-income/coupon convention

benchmark_assignment.pooled: Union of inherited eligible equity, bond and mixed fund-origins, each with its own origin-type benchmark. There is no single pooled benchmark series. Unknown/other focus does not default to IMOEX and has an explicit exclusion reason.
benchmark_assignment.focus_timing: Use the existing dated classification at d_t, not the fund's latest observed focus. Keep b_f_t fixed for all future months and the one past control of that origin, even if a later report changes focus.
benchmark_assignment.definition_limits: IMOEX excludes stock dividends; RGBITR is a government-bond total-return series. The broad fund series is not certified payout-complete TR. These asymmetric return conventions are explicit features of this requested comparison, not evidence of like-for-like total-return performance. No alternative benchmark is selected after results.

origin_and_score_rules.origins: Reuse the complete selected-origin set in the sealed panel before outcome/history restrictions, with inherited universe_eligible and identity_origin_verified. One selected latest genuine closing report per fund/calendar month; no fallback to an earlier same-month report after a failure.
origin_and_score_rules.universe: Retain dated fund focus, identified index/passive exclusions, mandate/currency/identity rules and provisional-status flags. Do not require survival or introduce a new minimum holdings history, domestic-share threshold or security count.
origin_and_score_rules.scores: Reuse values, eligibility and reasons unchanged. Independent current and lagnews usable sets; no 50% coverage gate, no two-company gate, no paired-set gate. Confirmed observed-subportfolio zeros remain zero; technical missingness, empty usable sets and missing predecessor windows remain NA. No new score reconstruction or restoration beyond the sealed panel.
origin_and_score_rules.scope: NTS describes alignment in the observed corporate subportfolio. Its zero group mixes supported inactivity/absence, balanced signals and offsetting alignment; it does not prove no news or trades throughout the fund. Raw Net, B_Q and inherited quantity/outlier exclusions are unchanged.

outcome.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of monthly return differences, not a compounded fund/index wealth ratio, not cumulative h-month excess return, not a risk-free excess return and not alpha.
outcome.calendar: Use exactly m_t+1 through m_t+h. Exclude the partial remainder of the origin month. All h fund returns and all h assigned-benchmark returns must be finite and individually eligible; missing any month yields NA for that horizon, not a shorter average, zero or interpolation.
outcome.fund_future_anchor: Retain the actual-origin safeguard: the first future fund return's observed start_valuation_date must exist and be >= d_t. Preserve actual start/end valuation dates, return_period_end and the ignored origin-month tail. Never replace d_t with a nominal month-end to force eligibility.
outcome.benchmark_endpoints: Use the assigned index's adjacent calendar-month official closing levels, with their actual last-trading-day dates and series-specific calendar verification. Do not borrow levels across an absent month or turn a missing/stale endpoint into zero return. Benchmark and fund returns must refer to the same calendar months; retain any differences in actual valuation dates.
outcome.return_quality: Inherit frozen fund-month quality/action/identity gates, including genuine adjacent endpoints and the existing endpoint-age convention. No new return trimming/winsorisation, range search, data imputation or payout assumptions. Fund return must be finite and >=-1; verified positive index levels imply finite index return >-1.

past_return_control.selection: m_star is the latest eligible matched fund/assigned-index month whose CALENDAR month-end is <= d_t and whose fund return_period_end, fund start/end valuation dates and both benchmark endpoint dates are all <= d_t. Require finite eligible returns. This is a date-based maximum, never a return-value-based choice.
past_return_control.boundary_examples: If d_t is before the calendar month-end, the control month cannot be m_t, even when the last trading day has already occurred. If d_t equals calendar month-end, m_t may be used when all endpoint/date checks pass. Thus an origin on 2026-05-29 cannot use May as its past control; an origin on 2026-05-31 may use May if eligible.
past_return_control.gap_policy: If the latest calendar month is missing, take the most recent earlier eligible complete matched month, without synthesizing intervening returns. Record m_star, control_age_months and actual source dates; call this latest available past monthly performance, not an invariably one-month lag. No new age cutoff or long-history requirement. If no eligible past pair exists, P_f_t is NA and the row is excluded with that reason.
past_return_control.publication_vintage: Use known publication timestamps when available and require them not to exceed d_t for the control. Where publication vintage is unknown, retain the existing unknown-vintage limitation; endpoint dating alone does not establish real-time public availability. Do not invent dates or claim a tradable real-time strategy.
past_return_control.no_alpha_history: Exactly one valid past monthly control is sufficient. No 36-of-60, 9-of-12, beta conditioning, past_alpha, accumulated historical return or minimum NTS history is required.

variants.sample: Inherited eligible origin, known current score including supported zero, known outcome and past control. Do not require lagnews eligibility or a preceding news interval.

variants.formula: Y_f_t_h = a_f + theta_current*S_current + theta_lagnews*S_lagnews + gamma*P_f_t + error
variants.sample: Same gates plus independently known lagnews score, including supported zero. Unknown lagnews is not filled with zero.

model_grid.primary_display: h=1, all four groups and both variants; h=2 and h=3 are explicitly additional horizon tables, not candidates for choosing the most significant headline.
model_grid.no_extensions: No provider-TR4 branch, alpha-history sensitivities, alternate indices, blended mixed-fund benchmark, new controls, cuts, control subsets, nonoverlapping phases, extra common-sample fits, LLM refresh or benchmark search in this task.

estimation_and_inference.estimator: Unweighted fund-FE OLS; P_f_t is the only control. No fund-size/security-count weights, time effects, time clusters or company clusters.
estimation_and_inference.covariance: One-way fund CR1 with G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K_full); save the full covariance and correction. Main p-values and 95% intervals use ordinary two-sided Student t(G-1), not native residual df. Native output may be retained separately with correct labels.
estimation_and_inference.guards: Remove singleton funds transparently. Require N>=30, G>=2, positive residual df and identified finite target columns. Absorbed required NTS targets or collinear nonabsorbed regressors yield NOT_ESTIMABLE, with no silent target/control drop. A control exactly absorbed by fund FE may be omitted algebraically with its status disclosed, as in the inherited estimator.
estimation_and_inference.small_clusters: G<30 is flagged fragile and significance stars are suppressed. Do not relax guards to obtain estimates.
estimation_and_inference.joint_guard: Joint Wald F(2,G-1) requires G>=3 and a finite, identified, rank-two positive-definite target covariance. Otherwise NA with the exact reason, never eigenvalue clipping, p=1 or a negative statistic.
estimation_and_inference.undefined_tests: Nonfinite/nonpositive target variance gives an undefined SE/test with an explicit reason, not zero uncertainty or an invented p-value. Non-estimable models are not called insignificant.
estimation_and_inference.limits: Fund clustering accommodates serial dependence including overlapping horizons, but does not cover common shocks across different funds. Ordinary p-values across 24 cells are not family-wise error controlled. These limitations are reported, not repaired by an unrequested model change.
estimation_and_inference.effect_scale: Y is a decimal average monthly return difference. 10000*theta is basis points per +1 score; 20000*theta is the -1 to +1 contrast. An observed within-sample IQR contrast can also be reported with its IQR. The coefficient sum is a joint shift in two alignment scores, not a cumulative causal response.

interpretation.question: Does more news-aligned rebalancing predict higher subsequent fund-unit performance relative to the assigned market index, conditional on fund effects and latest available past index-relative performance?
interpretation.positive_result: A positive current coefficient supports predictive index-relative performance under this alternative outcome, not the original factor-alpha claim or managerial skill by itself. A positive lagnews coefficient concerns alignment with earlier news.
interpretation.nonpositive_result: Non-rejection is not proof of zero economic effect. A negative coefficient does not by itself identify price chasing, liquidity provision or limited information-processing skill.
interpretation.benchmark_risk: Subtracting the index implicitly uses a unit benchmark exposure and does not estimate beta. IMOEX is a deliberately simple but imperfect comparison for mixed funds with bonds/cash. RGBITR may differ from bond-fund portfolios in duration, credit risk and composition. No risk-neutral or mandate-neutral comparison is claimed.
interpretation.comparisons_with_old_H3: The outcome and availability restrictions change, so a coefficient difference from alpha H3 is not attributable solely to a larger sample. Show overlap and inclusion reasons without fitting extra comparisons. Retain the previous alpha results and explicitly label this as a requested supplementary outcome.

required_outputs: Spec SHA and sealed, series-specific source/code manifest before new coefficients. Independent benchmark-source approval must precede fitting; unresolved benchmark scope is a blocker, not permission to substitute another index.

Full origin outcome/control ledger with fund focus, benchmark ID, future month members and returns, P_f_t month/age/date evidence, current/lagnews status, zero reasons and every exclusion. Large ledgers remain on PC.

Group/horizon/variant flow: inherited origin universe -> assigned benchmark -> complete future fund/index months -> past control -> current score -> both scores where required -> singleton removal -> inference. No alpha/history gate in this flow.

All 24 labels, exact used-sample hashes, native output under index-relative labels, coefficients/SE/t/p/CI, full covariance, current/lag/sum/joint tests, N/G/date ranges, within R2 and honest NOT_ESTIMABLE/undefined reasons.

h1 readable table with four group columns, benchmark labels, current-only and distributed panels, current/lagnews/control coefficients with SE/p, N/G, fund FE and within R2. Add h2/h3 in the same layout, preserving null cells. No minimum-p headline.

Current-only versus distributed sample overlap and comparison with old relaxed-alpha sample, using stored IDs only; no extra fits. Report changes in eligibility without attributing them solely to one mechanism.
Separate independent data/numerical QA plus bounded interpretation review. Do not label executor checks alone independent QA.
QA_acceptance: The sealed NTS values, zero/NA statuses, origin dates, universe/focus, raw quantity and outlier policy are unchanged. No score is recomputed from newer news.
Equity and mixed use IMOEX; bond uses RGBITR; pooled is assigned by dated origin type. No current/latest-focus backfill, silent RGBI/MCFTR substitution or unrelated-factor eligibility gate.
Each Y equals the arithmetic mean of exactly h observed fund-minus-assigned-index monthly returns in m_t+1..m_t+h. Both sides have the same month keys; missing a month gives NA.

Actual future fund anchor is not earlier than origin. All past-control month ends and source endpoint dates are <= origin; the selected month is the latest eligible past pair. Save stale-control ages instead of synthesizing missing months.
An origin with valid one-month control/future returns but fewer than 36 historical months can qualify. It is not excluded for missing alpha, beta, RF, past_alpha or unrelated factors.
Current-only preserves known-current/unknown-lag observations; distributed requires both. Complete horizons are not forced to a common h1/h2/h3 sample.
All 24 cells and both signs are retained, including NA; N/G/rank/singleton/joint guards and t(G-1) covariance arithmetic match the frozen specification.
All preserved source/old-result hashes remain unchanged. Fund series is consistently labelled known-adjustment unit-value performance, not total NAV growth or verified total-return alpha.
